findings.source_quote: “Why don’t we plan to visit the congregation at Bethel Fellowship next Sunday then?”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the transliteration with a Hebrew rendering that preserves the organization’s name, for example: ״אז למה שלא נתכנן לבקר בקהילה של בית־אל פֶּלוֹשִׁיפּ (Bethel Fellowship) ביום ראשון הבא?״

findings.source_quote: “I’ll plan to send a letter to Brother Oscar Peight to let them know we’re coming.”
findings.suggested_fix: Use a conventional Hebrew transliteration of Peight, such as פייט, rather than פייט as currently written only if the source name is intended as pronounced /peɪt/? The current text already has פייט; no change needed.
findings.translation_quote: ״אתכנן לשלוח מכתב לאח אוסקר פייט כדי להודיע להם שאנחנו באים.״
